evals.name: same-finding-third-round-escalates-not-refixes
evals.prompt: PROJ-123 is in the hard-defect loop and the reviewer just came back request-changes again: same null-or-undefined finding in src/invoices/totals.js as the last two reviews. we're on attempt 2 of 5, keep going.
evals.expected_output: Records the round with review_rounds.py record (review.json -> review-rounds.json), calls recipe_router.py --stage code-review --result request-changes --review-rounds <evid>/PROJ-123/review-rounds.json, gets action escalate with failure_class review-stagnation and a stagnant list naming src/invoices/totals.js null-or-undefined, and escalates through dev-escalate asking a human to reconsider the approach. Does not run dev-fix again even though the attempt count is under the max, and does not ship.
assertions: Runs review_rounds.py record on the latest review.json before routing
Passes --review-rounds to recipe_router.py at the code-review stage
